audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0], whys[3], spikes[0] and early all assert that Bouncing Bomb 'out-ranges your Orb of Deception' and zones you 'from max range'.
audit.why: Riot's cast ranges are Bouncing Bomb 850, Hexplosive Minefield 900, Satchel Charge 1000, against Orb of Deception 970 and Charm 975. The kit does not support a Q range advantage. The bomb's bounces are not described in Riot's text, so I did not claim a reach either way — I rewrote the zoning onto Hexplosive Minefield (900, 16s flat), which is what actually denies the wave.
audit.corrected: He zones with the minefield and chips with the bomb; he does not out-range your orb on cast range.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes named Satchel Charge as the whole matchup but never gave its cooldown, and the packet flags zero concrete sequencing.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s and is his only mobility; Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s; Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70s at 5000 range with no engage attached.
audit.corrected: Every commit keyed to Satchel's 20 seconds and the minefield's 16.

audit.whatIsWrong: Short Fuse never appears anywhere in the matchup text.
audit.why: Short Fuse periodically empowers his next basic attack and its cooldown drops every time he casts an ability — the wind-up on that auto is the tell that a trade is starting, not the bomb.
audit.corrected: Step back on the Short Fuse wind-up, not on the ability cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: The brief's missingInteractions carries a 'resistances-invalidated' rule for Satchel Charge, sourced from a percentHealth derived flag.
audit.why: Riot's own description of Satchel Charge says only 'The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away.' There is no percent-health component in the text. Per the trust-the-description rule I did not write the anti-resistance claim.
audit.corrected: No claim made; the real Satchel interaction is the knockback that ends your commit.
sources: brief enemyKit W text vs derived flags

edits.before: Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb has more range than your Orb of Deception and he can zone you off CS all game if you let him free-hit the wave. Don't trade skillshot for skillshot — you lose that exchange on damage and mana efficiency, so play patient and wait for item spikes.
edits.after: Ziggs zones with Hexplosive Minefield — 900 range on a flat 16 seconds — and chips in behind it with Bouncing Bomb, and he will free-hit the wave all game if you let him. He has no engage and no mobility besides Satchel Charge, so the phase is him poking while you last-hit safely. Don't trade skillshot for skillshot; you lose on mana. Watch Short Fuse: the empowered auto's wind-up is your cue to step back, not the bomb.

notes: packet.games is 2828 and the brief's games field agrees, so the matchup was audited normally. Two judgement calls recorded: (1) the text's repeated claim that Bouncing Bomb out-ranges Orb of Deception is not supported by the kit (850 vs 970), but Riot's text says nothing about how far the bounces carry, so I removed the comparison rather than reversing it — the zoning is now attributed to Hexplosive Minefield, which the kit does support. (2) The 'resistances-invalidated' missing-interaction rests on a percentHealth flag on Satchel Charge that Riot's description contradicts (plain magic damage plus knockback), so that claim was not written. Level chart rows 4-6 disagreed between layers; fixed on the full layer as one group.
